The hypothesis is strengthened by the secondary resonator_obs transition on day 34–35 (events 110369, 359879, 136540, 663229, 139448, 1031672), which shows no change in autocorrelation structure before or after, consistent with a transient that was already decaying and is decoupled from apparatus state changes.
